title: Beyond Binary Gender: Evaluating Gender-Inclusive Machine Translation with Ambiguous Attitude Words

bias_targets.methodology: Substituting binary and non-binary gender identity terms (e.g., man, woman, transgender, genderqueer) into source sentences containing ambiguous attitude words, and evaluating the resulting machine translations for performance degradation (COMET, BLEU) and negative sentiment shifts using an LLM-based Emotional Attitude Score (EAS).

Substituting sexual orientation terms (e.g., lesbian, gay, bisexual, queer) into source sentences containing ambiguous attitude words, and assessing the machine translation outputs for translation quality differences and emotional/sentiment shifts using the Emotional Attitude Score (EAS).
